palette: Matched to approved vanilla atlas palette: deep blue sea, light-blue shallow coastal band, pale-green lowlands, green middle elevations, ochre highlands. Vanilla coastline mask follows the prior approved map; War Sails land/water classes are harmonized with its navigation-water classification.
limitations: War Sails water map uses a previously rendered navmesh plot, calibrated from visible axis ticks; exact pixel-to-scene validation still requires original navmesh.bin/rendering script. War Sails port XY remains the candidate coordinate interpretation documented in RES-012.
